mod.help: Settings for the Speed Multiplier mod.

all.label: All Player Actions
all.help: Speed of everything you do. Anything but 1 overrides the individual player speeds.

actions.title: Player Actions
actions.help: How fast you attack, cast and use items.

cast.label: Cast
cast.help: Speed of casting sorceries and incantations.

item.label: Item
item.help: Speed of using items such as flasks.

other.label: Other
other.help: Speed of any action not listed here.

torrent_all.label: All
torrent_all.help: Speed of everything Torrent does. Anything but 1 overrides the rows below.

torrent_other.label: Other
torrent_other.help: Speed of any other Torrent action.

others.title: Spirit & Enemy
others.help: How fast summoned spirits and enemies act.

enemy.label: Enemy
enemy.help: Speed of hostile enemies and bosses.

log.label: Log file
log.help: Write a log file next to the DLL, for troubleshooting.
